about_mission: ACS Mulinguae ena pou bi permet dimoun kominike <bold>efikasman</bold> ek <bold>avek konfians</bold> dan diferan lang, prepar zot pou reisi dan enn lemond ki pe vinn toulezour pli konekte, an mem tan protez ek devlop langaz lokal ek rezyonal. Nou promouvwar <bold>miltilingwism</bold> pa zis kouma enn abilite, me osi kouma enn kad sosyal ek kiltirel kapav lite kont <bold>lingwisid</bold> ek <bold>lingwism</bold>. Nou misyon osi baze lor <bold>lespwar</bold>, <bold>egalite</bold> ek <bold>realisasyon</bold>. Nou travay pou agrandi akse ek loportinite edikatif an ofer bann progran langaz ki ena enn o nivo kalite ek ki donn pouvwar bann lider kominoter, travayer ek etidyan tou laz ki angaze dan progre personel ek kolektif atraver ledikasyon. Atraver sa travay-la, ACS Mulinguae kree enn kominote dinamik bann etidyan langaz ek ranforsi konpreansyon, kolaborasyon ek konesans ant bann kiltir diferan.
about_story: ACS Mulinguae enn linisyativ akademik ki fonksyonn anba <bold>Asosiasion Ccahuac Solidarite (ACS)</bold>, enn lorganizasion san profi ki finn etabli an 2010 dan Lima, Perou. ACS finn kree par enn ti group dimoun ki ti angaze pou adres bann defi estriktirel <bold>lamizer</bold> ek <bold>deteriorasion lanvironnman</bold> ki afekte bann kominote vilnerab. Pandan bann lane, ACS finn devlop bann proze pou ranforsi <bold>rezilyans kominoter</bold>, inklir bann linisyativ pou promouvwar <bold>oto-sifizans alimanter</bold>, ogmant konsians lor <bold>resofman klimatik</bold> ek adres bann risk ogmante <bold>insekurite alimanter</bold>. Sa bann aksion-la baze lor enn konviksyon ki <bold>devlopman dirab</bold> bizin dirize par kominote, responsab lor plan ekolozik ek inklizif lor plan sosyal. Ledikasyon toultan finn enn sant misyon ACS. Nou konsider li kouma enn zouti esansiel pou <bold>transformasion sosyal</bold> ek <bold>empowerment</bold> lor enn long term. Dan sa kad-la, ACS Mulinguae pous bann linisyativ edikatif ki depas aksion lokal pou angaz bann kominote lor enn nivo global. Atraver so bann progran, li viz agrandi akse a konesans, promouvwar <bold>dialog ant kiltir</bold> ek kontribie dan <bold>devlopman imin dirab</bold> dan diferan kontks.
about_vision: Nou aspir pou vinn enn <bold>fourniser global lider</bold> dan ledikasyon miltilingw online, donn pouvwar bann individi ek lorganizasion pou atenn zot bi lingwistik ek edikatif avek konfians ek lexelans. Nou imazinn enn lemond kot dimoun kapav kominike libreman dan diferan lang, kas bann <bold>barier kiltirel</bold> ek promouvwar konpreansyon, kolaborasyon ek respe ant bann kominote diferan. Nou misyon se fer <bold>ledikasyon langaz o nivo</bold> vinn akse pou tou dimoun—san konsider zot lokasion, zot fon sosyal-ekonomik ouswa zot loportinite edikatif avan—an itiliz teknolozi pou ofer bann lexperyans inovatif, inklizif ek etidyan-santre. Nou rekonet diversite profon bann etidyan ek zot kontks kiltirel. Alor, nou adopte bann lapros pedagozik ki <bold>sanzib a kiltir</bold> ek ankre dan bann lang, tradision ek sistem konesans lokal, asire ki miltilingwism vinn enn pon pou <bold>empowerment</bold> ek pa pou asimilasion.
about_tutors: Nou bann profeser se bann <bold>profesyonel edikatif kalifie ek experimante</bold> ki swiv striktman bann prinsip etik ki finn etabli dan Charter Profeser ek bann standar pli o konportman profesyonel. Laplipar zot <bold>biling ouswa miltiling</bold>, ranforsi nou langazman institisionel pou <bold>inklizion lingwistik</bold> ek <bold>kompetans ant kiltir</bold>. Devlopman profesyonel kontinie enn exizans santral dan lorganizasion. Bann profeser partisip dan formasion struktire ek aprantisaz tou long lavi, defini kouma enn progre soutenu ek auto-dirize lor <bold>konesans pedagozik</bold>, <bold>expertiz disiplinn</bold> ek <bold>pratik ansennman</bold>. Sa asire ki zot aligne avek bann standar edikatif ki pe evolie ek bann bezwin bann popilasion etidyan diferan. Bann profeser form <bold>la kolonn operasionel ek stratezik</bold> proze. Zot zwe enn rol kle pa zis dan livrezon progran, me osi dan planifikasion, swivi ek sipervizion implementasion, asire <bold>garanti kalite</bold>, <bold>responsabilite</bold> ek <bold>koerans misyon</bold> lor tou nivo.
